payload.title: Correct physical-line source search spans
payload.summary: Repository code search can fail to build its index, select incorrect Python declarations, or report misleading source/window line locations when valid source contains non-newline separators within strings or comments. Diagnose and correct this end-to-end source representation defect. Python physical lines are LF, CRLF or CR; other Unicode/ASCII separators are source characters, not physical line breaks. Preserve exact original Unicode and newlines, decorated/nested synchronous and asynchronous symbol spans, canonical declaration/occurrence identity, enclosing expansion and deterministic overlapping windows. Non-Python windows must use the same physical-line convention. Invalid Python must retain the documented file fallback. Preserve APIs and existing ranking behavior. Do not alter tests or acceptance.
payload.uncertainty: Independent oracle and unchanged regressions determine correctness; local evaluation does not grant protected publication.
dependencies: Existing Context and RI source identity contracts
